clues.it: Ugo era nella 6ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Irene.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 6th column, in the 1st row and in the same room as Irene.

clues.it: Vito era nella 1ª colonna e nella 2ª riga, ma non era accanto a una cuccetta.
clues.en: Vito was in the 1st column and in the 2nd row, but was not beside a bunk.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 2ª colonna e a nord di Carla.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 2nd column and north of Carla.

clues.it: Irene era nella 7ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e a ovest di Sergio.
clues.en: Irene was in the 7th column, in the 4th row and west of Sergio.

clues.it: Giada era nella 5ª riga, in una stanza diversa da Sergio e in Cabina.
clues.en: Giada was in the 5th row, in a different room from Sergio and in the Cabin.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a un barile e a nord di Luca.
clues.en: Marta was beside a barrel and north of Luca.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 8ª colonna, nella 7ª riga e accanto a una sedia.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 8th column, in the 7th row and beside a chair.

clues.it: Luca era nella 10ª colonna, nella 8ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Giada.
clues.en: Luca was in the 10th column, in the 8th row and in a different room from Giada.

clues.it: Olga era accanto a un salvagente ed esattamente una riga a nord di Dario.
clues.en: Olga was beside a life ring and exactly one row north of Dario.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Carla era in una stanza diversa da Fabio.
clues.en: Carla was in a different room from Fabio.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 6th.
